title: Exercise and resting heart rate (illustrative data)
caption: Illustrative data for practice, not real measurements. The points fall from left to right: a strong negative correlation.
alt: A scatter diagram of resting heart rate against hours of exercise per week for 10 people, from 0 to 7 hours. The points fall from about 82 to 62 beats per minute, close to a dashed line of best fit.
description: x-axis: exercise per week, 0 to 7 hours.
y-axis: resting heart rate, about 60 to 85 beats per minute.
Ten points falling from left to right, close to a line: a strong negative correlation.

checks.name: the line of best fit passes through the mean of the data (a least-squares line)
